critical_code_review_comments: FieldLeadershipHub.jsx imports paletteFor and immediately uses FL_PAL on line 31 BEFORE the remaining imports finish (lines 32-45). It works because ES module imports are hoisted at parse time, but mixing a top-level non-import statement between import lines is a style/lint smell — recommend moving the FL_PAL declaration to AFTER all imports for readability.

ShopHub only has a single back-to-hub link (`shop-back-hub`) while HR/Dispatch/FL all use a paired `*-nav-home` + `*-nav-back` pattern. Naming is inconsistent across the platform. Consider renaming ShopHub's link to `shop-nav-home` for testid parity even if Back stays optional.

tailwind.config.js has NO explicit safelist. The new `hubKickerStatic` literals work today only because portalPalette.js is in the `src/**` content glob. If the file is ever moved (e.g. to `shared/` or a workspace package) the classes will purge silently. Recommend adding a safelist entry for the 6 kicker colors to harden against future refactors.
